findings.title: Supply is concentrated
findings.detail: The top 10 owners control 63.3% of supply once linked wallets are merged (it looks like 59.6% if you count wallets naively).

findings.title: 7 hidden wallet clusters
findings.detail: 42 top-holder wallets resolve to 7 linked groups holding 53.9% of supply. The largest (30 wallets) holds 52.6%.

findings.title: Fresh wallets are driving demand
findings.detail: Brand-new wallets net bought $2,153,449 this week, far outpacing proven traders.

findings.title: Smart Money is holding
findings.detail: 24 Smart Money wallets hold 1.8% of supply.
